verdict.rationale: GitCafe documents Git over SSH and attaches SSH keys to accounts: GitHub-synced sign-ups import the SSH keys from the user's GitHub profile with default SSH access, skipping unusable keys. The only documented way keys get onto an account, though, is this GitHub import; no direct registration flow is shown. Missing for 10: documented way to add or register SSH keys directly in GitCafe (UI, CLI or API) without GitHub sync, key management (listing, removal, access scopes), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
